st: Mariel Hemingway, Kevin Brown, Curtis Armstrong
d: A deadly presence inhabits Mariel's home, threatening her very existence; Kevin nearly perishes in a deadly fire when his life is saved by someone from the other side.

A nightmare starts when Chris starts renovating his family dream house. A ghost haunts the home. Only with the help of paranormal investigators, priests, psychics, and shamans does Chris figure out a way to protect his family and "evict" the evil spirit.
A shadowy presence manifests from the darkened corners of Judy McCarthy’s Texas home.

t: A Haunting: When The Lights Go Out
d: After newlyweds Brooke and Dominic Ardolino experience strange paranormal events in their home, they call in investigators who uncover two spirits – one is trying to warn them while the other is dangerous.

t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett
d: Could vampires be real?  A well-known U.S. paranormal investigator and folklorist  in New York City recounts the legend and evolution of the vampire throughout history and from culture to culture.
Ryan Buell and company set out on one of their most dangerous cases to date--to help a single mother who is experiencing paranormal activity in a home that was once the site of brutal murders.
Kim Russo accompanies her on this journey and explains why Kelly has attracted these spirits.

t: My Ghost Story: The Evil Down Below
d: A scientist discovers footage on his security camera that even he can't explain; and a sailing ship from the 1800's is home to a ghostly crew.

P.R.S. is called in to help a young mother tormented by an otherworldly connection to a teenage girl murdered in her neighborhood years ago. Could she have psychic ability or is there a more sinister force at work?

Jay Yaple persuades his wife that Enfield, CT, is the perfect place for them. After a series of unexplained events, Jay discovers the house has a dark history of mysterious deaths. Anyone who attempts to come to their aid is driven away by the demon.

st: The Mysterious Disappearance of Roanoke Colony

Actress Diane Farr (Numb3rs, Private Practice) fears that a ghost is causing unexplained havoc in her California home.

Sarah believes her Parkville, MD home has been invaded by a powerful force ever since her roommate Dennis moved in.
Legendary actor, Kevin Sorbo returns to an idyllic lake in Texas where he encountered a ghostly apparition so disturbing it haunts him to this day.
Music icon Paula Abdul brings psychic medium Kim Russo back to her former California home where she was troubled by incessant spirits.
